step.prompt: /crew-patterns Confirm or change the architecture style in docs/adr/ADR-001 for Teamly given docs/03 (two developers, four weeks, FastAPI + Postgres + React, one cloud), pick the design patterns the P0 problems need, record the pattern table in docs/13-conventions.md section 3, update .anycrew/config.json architecture.style and architecture.patterns, and finish. Do not ask questions; mark assumptions.
step.judge: Read docs/adr/ADR-001-architecture-style.md, docs/13-conventions.md and .anycrew/config.json. Score 5 if the ADR now names the forces (team, horizon, change hot spots, integrations, consistency, scale, operations), compares at least two styles with costs, is Accepted or superseded by a new ADR, the pattern table lists pattern / where / why for concrete P0 problems with the 'avoid when' check answered, there is a Mermaid diagram of the shape, and the config records style and patterns. Score 3 if the decision is recorded but forces or avoid-checks are missing. Score 1 if it is a generic essay.

judge.reason: ADR-001 is Accepted with a forces table (team/horizon, change hot spots, integrations, consistency, scale/cost, operations), five styles compared with costs, a Mermaid flowchart and an answered 'Avoid this style when' check; docs/13 §3 lists pattern/where/why for the P0 problems (FR/NFR cited) with considered-and-rejected patterns; .anycrew/config.json records style modular-monolith and nine pattern slugs.
